column1: # Managed by @plainconceptsplatform/workflows. Source: loops/templates/quality-gates/.zap/rules.tsv. Update with `workflows update --force`; consumer edits may be overwritten.
# Each entry is a reviewed decision about one rule, and the justification column is mandatory.
# An IGNORE that a fix would remove names the issue tracking that fix. Never add an IGNORE just
# to turn the job green: fix the finding, or record here why the rule does not apply to the app.
# An app that needs a triage line of its own takes this file over: remove the header line above.
# Shared by the platform family. 10020, 10021, 10035, 10038, 10063, 90004 and 10015 are fixed at
# source by the platform security headers (Api/Security/SecurityHeaders.cs), and 90003 by
# self-hosting Geist Mono, so none of them appears here. See Foundations ai/ENGINEERING.md.
# OUTOFSCOPE lines take a URL regex as the third column instead of a justification, so the
# justification sits in the comment above each one.
# An anonymous / answers only with a 302 to the Entra sign-in. ZAP follows it and files
# login.microsoftonline.com's page, headers and cookies (esctx, fpc, x-ms-gateway-slice) under
# the app's /, so the header and cookie rules fire on a page the app does not serve. The app's own
# headers on that redirect come from the same middleware as /login, which stays in scope.

column3: Non-Storable / Storable Content: informational, describes caching semantics, not a defect. The shell and API are no-store on purpose; hashed _next/static assets are immutable on purpose.
Modern Web Application: informational, ZAP noting the target is a JavaScript SPA, which is why the scan uses the AJAX spider.
Session Management Response Identified: informational, ZAP recognising the App Service ARRAffinity cookie as a session token. Not a finding.

CSP analysis: style-src carries 'unsafe-inline' because Radix UI and React inline style attributes need it; script-src does not use unsafe-inline: the build emits per-script SHA-256 hashes (scripts/extract-csp-hashes.mjs). The rest of the policy is pinned by SecurityHeadersTests.
